evidence.oralText: Claude Code usage limits might be getting smaller. (Esp $20 pro plan). Two weeks ago, 84% of the weekly limit represented around 515M tokens. This week, 51% represents only 220M tokens.
evidence.conflictsToKeep: This is a compiled comparison graphic, not a raw official console screenshot, though the footer says numbers were taken from each dashboard. API-equivalent dollars are not the subscription quota. Raw token counts at a given usage % can shrink when model mix, cache rates, or weighting change, even if the official pool is unchanged. 'Wasted' is the author's label. Do not treat 432.1M or $423.72 as an official published weekly pool, and do not splice weeks into one number.
evidence.why: 作者自制多周对照图，不是原始官方控制台；token 与 API-equivalent 会随模型组合和缓存变化，不能当成官方周池在缩小的裁定证据。
